pages.text: $(d)Spectre Chargers$() are used to charge items in your inventory with FE from your $(l:irregular_implements:blocks/spectre_energy_injector)Spectre Energy Buffer$(/l).$(br2)While active, it will charge every item in your inventory, including armor and Curio slots.
Each tier charges faster than the last. The $(d)Genesis Spectre Charger$() is creative only, and does not use your Spectre Energy Buffer's energy.
